tokens.title: API and device tokens
tokens.help: A token lets a script or an app use Meshloom without your password. Create one per device.
tokens.ingressNotice: Tokens do not work through Home Assistant: the device must reach Meshloom at its own address.
tokens.createHelp: The token belongs to your account and never gets more than your role allows.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.scopesHelp: Tick only what the device needs. Only the scopes your role allows are offered.

scope.read: Channels, contacts, packets and the map.
scope.send: Send messages and edit contacts and channels.

tokens.secretWarning: Copy this token now: it will not be shown again.
tokens.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the token and copy it by hand.
tokens.secretUsage: Send it as “Authorization: Bearer <token>” on every request.
tokens.revokeHelp: The token stops working at once and any connection open with it is closed. This cannot be undone.
